title: RetroArch Session Time by Core
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=retroarch:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(session_min) as session_minutes by core _time
| sort - session_minutes
description: Uses RetroArch session logs telemetry to monitor weekly playtime across emulation cores in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for which retro systems are actually getting attention, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest RetroArch session logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly leaderboard of RetroArch core playtime.
grandmaExplanation: It produces weekly playtime across emulation cores so you can spot which retro systems are actually getting attention before it becomes annoying.
